description: Edits signing field settings, options, validation, preferences, conditions, and formulas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the current field should be copied to all pages.

parameters.name: CopyToAllPagesRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a radio or multiple option should be mapped to a document area.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Whether the panel should prevent edits.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Culture used to preview localized field labels in nested editors.

parameters.name: FieldChanged
parameters.description: Selected signing field edited by the panel.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Callback invoked whenever the edited field changes.

parameters.name: OptionAreaMappingRequested
parameters.description: Whether to show authoring controls for localized signer-facing text.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Submitter roles available for assigning the edited field.

parameters.name: ShowLocalizationEditor
parameters.description: Cultures available for editing localized signer-facing text.

parameters.name: SubmitterRoles
parameters.description: All fields in the current signing template, used by condition and formula builders.

parameters.name: SupportedCultures
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized labels are missing.
